newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's UBK says 96 dividend steady.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's UBK says 96 dividend steady.

text.p: Slovenian bank UBK said on Thursday it would pay an unchanged dividend for 1996 despite a fall in profits.
The dividend for shares B, which are listed on the main market of the Ljubljana bourse, will remain at 720 tolars.
UBK said it could pay the dividend out of reserves from 1995.
The bank said 1996 net profit fell to 2.1 million tolars from 120.3 million in 1995 due to a fall in corporate deposits. The bank had forecast a net profit of 11.7 million.
Balance sheet assets eased to 13.2 billion tolars from 13.9 billion.
Slovenia's second-largest bank SKB earlier on Thursday said it would buy 51 percent of UBK. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
